user.title: Taipower bill estimate
user.description: Estimate this period's Taipower bill from your existing meter sensor. Rates are bundled; update the integration when Taipower changes tariffs.

data_description.source: Cumulative kWh sensor (state_class: total_increasing). If you only have a power (W) sensor, create an Integration helper to turn it into kWh first; Emporia Vue users: use a kWh sensor such as *_1mon. See the README.
data_description.reading_day: Clamped to month end. The period resets at 00:00 on this day.
data_description.initial_used: If you know this period's usage so far, fill it in; otherwise measuring starts now and the estimate extrapolates the measured rate.

abort.already_configured: This meter sensor is already configured.

error.source_is_power: That is a power (W/kW) sensor, not accumulated energy. Create an Integration helper that integrates it into kWh first, then pick the helper. How: {integration_doc}
error.source_not_kwh: That sensor's unit is not kWh (Wh/MWh would be off by 1000x). Pick a kWh sensor, or convert it with a template/Integration helper. See: {integration_doc}
